answer: A newcomer posts a 5 POA ferrous-stamped bond frozen in a glacier vault, thawing only after three strangers re-run its live job and confirm real use; a gale courier flies the signed proof to a distant client who echoes it back. A failed check keeps the bond frozen and burns it. The nth identity from one wallet posts 5n-squared POA (1st 5, 10th 500, 1,925 across ten); clones cannot share one thaw, and one operator cannot freeze ten bonds at once.
